decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - It is considered that the submitted details of windows and doors will provide for an acceptable appearance and satisfactory sound proofing provided the windows are kept closed during services and sound amplification is not used or is limited. This will be in accordance with London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 adopted  Policies ENV-B.1. (New Development) and ENV-P.1.5 (Noise Pollution). Similarly the other information submitted in respect of soundproofing shows satisfactory attenuation, subject to the above proviso, in accordance with policy ENV-P.1.5.  It should be noted that the Council's powers to prevent statutory noise nuisance, if it should arise, are not affected by the terms of a planning decision to approve these details. Part 3 of the Environment Protection Act 1990 can still be used to take action on such nuisance.  The details of Windows and Doors and of Sound Insulation can, therefore, be discharged.

It is considered that the details of disabled access to the building and of the disabled standard car parking space are also acceptable providing satisfactory access to the building and convenient and appropriate parking. This is in accordance with relevant Unitary Development Plan 2003 adopted policies ENV-B.1.8 Access and Facilities for People with Disabilities, E.3.1 Disabled Access, C.4.3 Physical Access to Social and Community Facilities and T.1.4 Car and Cycle Parking Facilities for Developments, and also the Council's "Think Access- Design for Accessibility" (2000) guidelines. The details of Disabled Persons Access and Disabled Persons Parking can, therefore, be discharged.
description: Following approval for demolition of existing ancillary building and the erection of a two storey church and an atrium linkway to site details submitted pursuant to Conditions 3 (windows and doors) and 5 (sound insulation), 8 (disabled persons access), and 12 (disabled persons parking) of planning permission 01049/E/P6 approved 04/09/2003.
